verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so a month-end close checklist is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a close checklist, reconciliation tracking, accrual tracking, or review sign-offs. The cited material covers API authentication, contacts, invoicing, payments, webhooks, sandboxes and versioning, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
